{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "own": "<id from her_items or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description", ""her_items" — her own items; an item of the description that is one of them gets its id in "own""]}, "description": "Sleeveless mock-neck knit top, fitted, cropped to the waist, ivory (#F2EDE4), fine-gauge viscose-blend knit

High-waisted A-line midi skirt, falling just below the knee, charcoal black (#2B2A2E), textured wool-blend bouclé

Cropped tweed-style jacket, slightly boxy, hip-skimming, black and ivory fleck (#3A383B), wool-blend tweed

White slingback flat sandals with black lug sole, her own from the photo, white (#FFFFFF), faux leather

Sheer black tights, 20 denier, black (#1C1B1E), nylon-elastane

Small structured shoulder bag, black (#1A191C), smooth faux leather

Drop earrings, small, silver (#C0C0C0), polished metal

Why this outfit works: The neat social look of a refined knit with a textured skirt and jacket suits a Saturday-evening birthday party, and the tweed adds an autumn feel without being heavy. The black and ivory palette repeats the monochrome of her white sandals with their black soles, so the shoes she chose look planned rather than added. The ivory knit sits softly near her face and brings out her blue-grey eyes against her dark hair, and the midi skirt's A-line shape defines the waist and balances the hips. Sheer tights and the light jacket keep her warm enough for an autumn night, while silver earrings add a little sparkle under evening lighting.", "her_items": [{"id": "її-ф1", "name": "White slingback flat sandals with black lug sole"}]}
